changelog:
Initial release of Technical SEO Checker.

- Provides comprehensive technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexability, site speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile-friendliness, security, structured data, and URL structure.
- Identifies technical issues affecting search engine crawling, indexing, and performance.
- Includes detailed audit templates for crawlability, indexability, performance, and more.
- Supports both automated audits (with connector integrations) and manual audits (with user-provided data).
- Offers clear usage instructions and sample prompts for full audits, issue checks, and pre-migration reviews.
- Routes content and link-related issues to other specialized skills as needed.
